policy: Add-only. Every review-queue gloss is kept unchanged; this file adds the English evidence English Wiktionary supplies: resolved form-of lemmas, close variants, translation-table equivalents, usage examples with English translations, and romanizations. Definitions are ranked (own sense corroborated by a translation table, then own sense in Wiktionary order with obsolete/archaic/rare senses last, then resolved lemma, close variant, translation equivalent). The lead candidate is a reviewer's starting point; nothing is selected or approved.

definitions.text: Optionally used after a noun to introduce its definition or explanation. In the most formal texts, separated from the noun by an em dash, or (дли́нное) тире́ ((dlínnoje) tirɛ́). In more informal texts, may be separated by a hyphen (дефи́с (defís)), due to typological constraints, or only a space. Often omitted, though usually not when the dash/hyphen is also omitted, to avoid introducing ambiguity.

definitions.text: Used as a personal pronoun when not referring to a particular noun. Translated as "it".

examples.text: Не́которые лю́ди говоря́т на не́скольких языка́х. Э́то позволя́ет им ду́мать и ви́деть мир по-дру́гому. Э́то та́кже мо́жет расши́рить возмо́жности трудоустро́йства.

definitions.text: Used as a personal pronoun when not referring to a particular noun. Translated as "it".

examples.text: Не́которые лю́ди говоря́т на не́скольких языка́х. Э́то позволя́ет им ду́мать и ви́деть мир по-дру́гому. Э́то та́кже мо́жет расши́рить возмо́жности трудоустро́йства.

definitions.text: Optionally used after a noun to introduce its definition or explanation. In the most formal texts, separated from the noun by an em dash, or (дли́нное) тире́ ((dlínnoje) tirɛ́). In more informal texts, may be separated by a hyphen (дефи́с (defís)), due to typological constraints, or only a space. Often omitted, though usually not when the dash/hyphen is also omitted, to avoid introducing ambiguity.

examples.text: Со́евое молоко́ — (э́то) напи́ток, полу́ченный из зёрен со́и.

examples.text: Одни́ насеко́мые крыла́ты, други́е лишены́ кры́льев
examples.english: Some insects are winged, others have no wings.
examples.roman: Odní nasekómyje kryláty, drugíje lišený krýlʹjev

definitions.display: inflection of оди́н (odín): dative plural: some (do something or have some quality), while others (do not do it; do something else; do not have this quality; or have another or the opposite quality)

definitions.text: one (out of five), poor; F mark, F grade
definitions.display: inflection of оди́н (odín): dative plural: one (out of five), poor; F mark, F grade
